name: Poke
description: Text-message assistant with an inbound API and npm CLI/SDK, so scripts, CI jobs and other agents can hand Poke tasks across email, calendar and connected apps.

skills.name: Send Poke a Task
skills.description: POST any JSON message to your Poke assistant, which acts on it with email, calendar, reminders and connected integrations.

skills.name: Create Webhook Triggers
skills.description: Create a condition-and-action webhook trigger with the SDK, then fire it with event data from any service.

skills.name: Add MCP Servers
skills.description: Connect remote MCP servers to Poke from the CLI, or tunnel a local MCP server so Poke can call its tools.
